entities.summary: The Seyidli Mosque was a former Shia Islam mosque, now in partial ruins, located in Shusha, Azerbaijan, approximately 350 km (220 mi) from Baku, the Azerbaijani capital. The former mosque is located on intersection of Telman and Garyaghdyogly streets.
